name: Runway
bestFor: Short generative clips and editing experiments with a mature product surface
skipIf: You need long-form film or a free YouTube downloader
keyFeatures: Mature browser video editor around the model
limitations: Short clip durations and plan-based watermarks/limits
summary: The established AI video bench. Credits disappear. Watermarks and duration caps matter more than demo reels.
body: Runway is where many teams still start with generative video because the editor around the model is real. Kling, Hailuo, and others may win a specific visual test this month. Runway wins “we can invoice this.” Illegal movie aggregators are not competitors; they are AdSense suicide.
notes: Storyboard on paper before you burn credits
Compare duration and resolution, not Twitter clips
